senses.gloss_en: Accusative singular: masculine animate nouns not ending in -а/-я use the genitive form; masculine/neuter inanimate nouns use the nominative form. First-declension nouns in -а/-я (masculine or feminine) take -у/-ю: Ва́ня → Ва́ню, ба́тюшка → ба́тюшку. Neuter -мя nouns keep the nominative form: и́мя → и́мя.
